add_comment.description: Post a comment on a Jira issue.
add_comment.display_name: Add a comment to a Jira issue
add_comment.display_str_template: Add a comment to Jira issue '{0}'.
add_comment.name: add_comment

parameters.description: Key of the Jira issue to comment on, for example PROJ-123.
parameters.name: issue_key

parameters.description: Text of the comment to post.
parameters.name: body

body.description: Comment text content that was posted to the issue

id.description: Comment ID (unique identifier for this comment)

create_issue.description: Create a new Jira issue with a title and an optional description, priority, and assignee.
create_issue.display_str_template: Create a Jira issue in project '{0}' titled '{1}'.
create_issue.name: create_issue

parameters.description: Key of the Jira project to create the issue in, for example PROJ.
parameters.name: project_key

parameters.description: Longer description of the issue. Supports Jira's text formatting.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Type of issue to create, for example Task, Bug, or Story.
parameters.name: issue_type

parameters.description: Name of the priority to set, for example High or Low.
parameters.name: priority

parameters.description: Account ID of the person to assign the issue to.
parameters.name: assignee_account_id

id.description: Jira issue ID (internal numeric identifier). Use the key field instead for most operations

self.description: Jira API URL for this issue. Can be used for direct API calls or constructing web UI links

get_issue_details.description: Look up a Jira issue's details, including its title and status.
get_issue_details.name: get_issue_details

parameters.description: Key of the Jira issue to look up, for example PROJ-123.
parameters.name: issue_key

id.description: Jira issue ID (internal numeric identifier). Use the key field instead for most operations

status.description: Current workflow status of the issue. Contains name and id for identifying the issue's state in the project workflow

id.description: Status ID in Jira's workflow configuration.

name.description: Current status name (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done'). Use jira_transition_issue to change this.

summary.description: Issue title/summary text. This is the main heading displayed in Jira

list_projects.description: List the Jira projects your connected account can access.
list_projects.name: list_projects

projects.description: Array of Jira projects accessible to the authenticated user. Each project contains id, key, and name. Use the key field when creating issues

list_transitions.description: List the status changes (transitions) available for a Jira issue based on its current status.
list_transitions.display_name: List transitions for a Jira issue
list_transitions.name: list_transitions

parameters.description: Key of the Jira issue to get transitions for, for example PROJ-123.
parameters.name: issue_key

transitions.description: Array of available transitions for the issue. Use the id field with transition_issue to move the issue

id.description: Transition ID. Pass this to transition_issue to move the issue to the target status

to.description: The status the issue will move to

search_issues.description: Find Jira issues using a Jira search query (JQL).
search_issues.name: search_issues

parameters.description: What to search for, written as a Jira search query (JQL). For example: project = PROJ AND status = 'In Progress'.
parameters.name: jql

parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, from 1 to 100.
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.description: To get more results, enter the next page token returned by the previous search.
parameters.name: next_page_token

issues.description: Array of Jira issues matching the search query. Each issue contains id, key, summary, status, and assignee fields. Use the key to perform actions on specific issues

assignee.description: Who the issue is assigned to. Both fields are empty strings when the issue is unassigned, so they are always safe to read

accountId.description: Account ID of the assignee. Pass it as assignee_account_id when creating an issue for the same person

displayName.description: Assignee's name as shown in Jira

status.description: Current workflow status of the issue

id.description: Status ID in Jira's workflow configuration

name.description: Status name as this project spells it (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Review', 'Done')

statusCategory.description: The broad category Jira files this status under

key.description: One of 'new', 'indeterminate', or 'done'. Use this, not the status name, to tell finished work from open work: every project names its statuses differently but they all map onto these three categories

next_page_token.description: Cursor token for fetching the next page. Absent when there are no more results

transition_issue.description: Move a Jira issue to a new status by applying a transition ID.
transition_issue.display_name: Move a Jira issue to a new status
transition_issue.name: transition_issue

parameters.description: Key of the Jira issue to move, for example PROJ-123.
parameters.name: issue_key

parameters.description: ID of the transition to apply. Use the list transitions action to find the available IDs.
parameters.name: transition_id

transition_issue.result_str_template: Jira issue moved to its new status.

transition_id.description: Transition ID that was applied. Available from Jira's workflow configuration for the project

description: Connect your Jira account to browse projects and create, update, and search issues.
